数据来自模型供应商响应中的 usage，仅为本次会话可观测到的用量，非账单依据。.en: Taken from the model provider's usage response for this conversation. Observable usage only, not a billing statement.

引用命名变量；未配置或留空时直接使用输入变量的原文；引用未定义变量将导致执行失败.en: named variables. If unset or empty the raw input variable is used; referencing an undefined variable fails the execution.

填报值 = 稳定对象标识；正式提交由服务端按契约解析并冻结 value/disp.en: The stored value is a stable object identifier. On submit the server resolves and freezes value/display per contract; forged or unauthorized objects are rejected.

该表单尚未发布过，暂无历史版本。.en: This form has never been published, so there is no version history.

当前表单尚未保存，暂无稳定表单标识。请先在「表单设计」区保存草稿后再管理关联流程.en: The form is not saved yet, so there is no stable form key. Save a draft in the design area before managing related processes.

此设置只控制普通用户是否能发起，不授予管理、数据或审批权限。.en: This setting only controls whether ordinary users can start the form. It grants no admin, data or approval permission.

此表单已发布，表名和字段已冻结，不可编辑。.en: This form is published: table name and fields are frozen and cannot be edited.

流程由系统按已发布表单绑定解析.en: The process is resolved by the system from the published form binding.

为「已发布 + 允许 IoT 接入」的流程模板配置设备动作：设备来源（设计时固定.en: Configure device actions for process templates that are published and IoT-enabled: device source (fixed at design / form field / process variable), capability, parameter fields and failure policy (block / log and continue / manual). The device dropdown lists eligible devices only (published + process-enabled + connection enabled).

流程联动仅可选择「已发布 + 允许 IoT 接入」的设备与流程模板.en: Process rules can only select devices and process templates that are published and IoT-enabled.

仅支持简单变量替换；不支持表达式、条件、脚本。变量值按纯文本处理。.en: Simple variable substitution only: no expressions, conditions or scripts. Variable values are treated as plain text.

第三方企业身份（企业微信 / 飞书 / 钉钉）绑定后可经企业统一身份入口登录；绑.en: After binding an enterprise identity (WeCom / Feishu / DingTalk) you can sign in through the corporate identity entry. Binding does not change local roles or permissions.

仅展示数据范围内且启用的用户；停用/不可见成员在回显时单独标记。.en: Lists enabled users within your data scope only; disabled or invisible members are marked separately when displayed.
